question: How can a wise one come to rest in the yogini heart without relying on further secret talk?
premises: Secret talk has a limited use for one seeking rest.
The yogini heart remains hidden by its own nature.
Resting there allows the wise one to become accomplished.
inference: For the wise one, cessation of secret discourse leads to rest in the naturally hidden yogini heart and to accomplishment.
uncertainties: Exact locus of the yogini heart remains context-dependent.
plain_english: Enough of secret talk, for the yogini heart is hidden by its own nature. There, the wise one who has come to rest becomes accomplished.
